historical_reviews.deepseek: Correct for literal manual AC removal but too absolute where an identified validated PDU exists; it also omits per-cycle inventory and telemetry evidence.

historical_reviews.v3_1: Separates the hazardous power action from automatable controller status, cold-boot readiness, logs, inventory and thermal/power collection.

original_test_intent: Perform exactly five controlled AC loss/restore cycles on the fully populated target and prove every cold boot returns without unexplained events, crash or loss of any device.
original_method: Bind host/PSU/PDU and device topology, preserve baselines, quiesce all writes, execute five approved off/dwell/on transitions, and after each collect power status, POST/boot, logs, inventory and health before continuing.
manual_activity: A trained operator must perform/supervise physical AC actions or approve the exact PDU outlets; the agent may control an approved PDU and collect per-cycle evidence only after topology and safety confirmation.
required_inputs: Backup, filesystem quiescence, maintenance window and five-cycle approval
Independent console/OOB recovery and known-event list
safety_requirements: Never infer or switch an outlet
Never cut AC during writes or firmware update
Verify zero/return power state and boot readiness each cycle
Stop on failed boot, device loss, unexplained event or telemetry loss
Do not continue after first anomaly
No automatic retry or hardware PASS claim
agent_execution_scope: Verify supplied topology and stable inventory
Capture pre-cycle data and health state
Operate only a validated approved PDU path
Abort and report without deciding the verdict
engineer_actions: Approve physical topology, timing and destructive impact
Perform or supervise every AC transition
Classify known events and recover failed boots

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correct for a site with manual unplug/replug only, but incomplete because a validated PDU can automate the action and evidence pipeline after approval.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use only the reviewed pinned project AC-cycle tool or trained physical procedure after exact outlet/feed validation; do not invent a generic power command.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Five AC cycles, full device population, 30/60-minute fields and no-error/no-device-loss criteria are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a state machine that records controller request/status, off dwell, power restore, POST/OS readiness and stable inventory diff for each of five cycles, with hard stop on deviation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds feed identity, data-quiescence proof and per-cycle traceability.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; exactly five cold cycles remain required.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Controller acknowledgement alone does not prove AC removal at the intended PSU feeds.

project_override_considerations: Redundant-feed sequencing and whether all feeds drop simultaneously must be explicitly defined; partial-feed tests cannot be reported as full AC-cycle coverage.
expected_evidence: Approval, quiescence, baseline logs and health
Five complete BMC/OS/SEL and thermal/power deltas
Final powered state and recovery record

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The title supplies five iterations and the body/criteria consistently define AC recovery and device retention; exact feed/load semantics are project inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: A verified PDU/operator path, topology and timing make the case executable; missing inputs require confirmation rather than permanent blocking.

review_improvement: Converts a generic manual unplug instruction into an interlocked five-cycle, stable-identity recovery audit with deterministic stop conditions.
independent_technical_reasoning: Physical AC interruption is hazardous, but an approved PDU and automated evidence collectors provide a meaningful executable path. The case therefore requires package/user confirmation rather than being inherently MANUAL ONLY.
